scope: R-055 through R-062: selected-text comments, connections/dependencies, graph, text links/backlinks, proof controls, document reports.

javascript.limit: DOM mocks and real refresh handlers; this is separate from the browser walkthrough.

browser.data: Isolated fictional library, two PRDs, generic role labels, one 99-byte proof file.
checks: Select words and open popup at selection
Post comment, show highlight and icon, open exact thread
Select and comment inside a clickable reference without navigating
Highlight follows view switch and keeps raw field text
Changed source wording retains original discussion without a false highlight
Add Connected to and Depends on links and inspect distinct graph edges
Graph includes three saved requirements across two PRDs
Local inline link navigates and focuses target; target lists backlink
Cross-PRD inline link opens and focuses the correct target
Save proof text and upload an attachment
Mark both fictional requirements Complete; completed report appears
Open readable HTML report and download ZIP with original proof bytes
Download embedded standalone proof; downloaded bytes verified
Change proof; Needs recheck appears, completed action hides, completed URL rejects
Ordinary report includes latest proof and Needs recheck
Second session sees same thread and posts reply; incoming reply preserves unfinished draft

resolved.issue: Async response could replace selected DOM while a comment selection was active.
resolved.fix: Store refreshed data, defer painting during selection, flush after collapse; regression covers four refresh lanes.

resolved.issue: Unparseable legacy review dates could pass the completed-report check.
resolved.fix: Treat unparseable date as a required-information gap; HTML and ZIP regression plus independent HTTP probes pass.

resolved.issue: Requirement navigation focus could be removed by subsequent refreshes.
resolved.fix: Stable requirement focus keys restore focus after repaint.

counterchecks: Symmetric duplicate rejection, directed cycles, stale add/remove, missing targets, self-links, invalid inputs
Consistent snapshots during concurrent document changes
Copied reference remapping and source qualification
Escaped HTML, safe attachment paths, duplicate filenames, original attachment bytes
Nested links/highlights, overlapping ranges, repeated text, emoji and UTF-16 offsets

limits: Chrome desktop only; mobile viewport override did not change the observed viewport, so a real phone layout was not verified.
No public team hosting or account authentication added; comments share the same running workspace.
No model quality, real product implementation, or time-saving evaluation performed.
